entities.name: Arthur
entities.description: A dragon with immense authority who stands at the center of Earth's Ruin.
entities.quote: Arthur stands at the center of it all. A true dragon. Not wings and fire alone—authority.

entities.name: Rowan
entities.description: A severely injured warrior who refuses to yield to Arthur and roars in defiance.
entities.quote: Rowan moves. His fingers twitch first. Then his shoulder jerks as he forces himself upright.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: A warrior who unleashes red lightning as he stands against Arthur.
entities.quote: Zayn steps forward. Lightning gathers around him, red and furious.

entities.name: Silas
entities.description: The original owner of the chains used by Rowan.
entities.quote: Silas’s chains. The ones given not as a weapon—but as a burden.

timeline_events.title: The Roar of Duskmoor
timeline_events.description: Rowan forces himself up from critical injuries and roars his refusal to surrender to Arthur, igniting Silas's chains.
timeline_events.quote: EPISODE SEGMENT — “THE ROAR OF DUSKMOOR” The Battlefield — Earth’s Ruin
